title: Claim-Status Follow-Up and Coordination-of-Benefits Settings — Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing)
content:
Follow-up on unanswered claims and the handling of second and third payers are set per payer class of the Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing).

| Payer class | First claim-status follow-up (days after acceptance with no remittance) | Later follow-ups every (days) | Unanswered follow-ups before escalation to the payer's provider representative | Coverage and coordination answers re-confirmed when older than (days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Commercial PPO Claim | 30 | 15 | 3 | 365 |
| Commercial HMO Claim | 30 | 15 | 3 | 365 |
| Marketplace Exchange Plan Claim | 30 | 15 | 3 | 365 |
| Medicare Advantage Plan Claim | 30 | 15 | 3 | 365 |
| Original Medicare Claim | 30 | 15 | 3 | 90 |
| BadgerCare Plus (Wisconsin Medicaid) Claim | 30 | 15 | 3 | 365 |
| Wisconsin Workers' Compensation Claim | 45 | 21 | 2 | 365 |

| Payer class | Secondary claim must be received within (days after the primary remittance date) | Payer crosses the claim over to the secondary payer automatically | Payer of last resort |
|---|---|---|---|
| Commercial PPO Claim | 90 | no | no |
| Commercial HMO Claim | 90 | no | no |
| Marketplace Exchange Plan Claim | 90 | no | no |
| Medicare Advantage Plan Claim | 90 | no | no |
| Original Medicare Claim | 365 | yes | no |
| BadgerCare Plus (Wisconsin Medicaid) Claim | 180 | no | yes |
| Wisconsin Workers' Compensation Claim | 90 | no | no |

Example (hypothetical): a claim accepted on day 0 with no remittance is first followed up on day 30 for a Commercial PPO Claim, and on day 45 for a Wisconsin Workers' Compensation Claim.
